method: box 40 x 30 x 20 with a corner at the origin: the edge y 0, z 0 is the X axis and the far corner is (40,30,20); the plane holds the origin and its normal is X x (0,30,20) = (0,-20,30), i.e. (0,-2,3)/sqrt(13): the plane 3z = 2y, which also holds the opposite edge's other end (0,30,20)
